T:P1.4.text: Carlisle Companies Incorporated is a leading supplier of innovative Building Envelope products and solutions for more energy efficient buildings. Through its building products businesses – Construction Materials (CCM) and Weatherproofing Technologies (CWT) – and family of leading brands, Carlisle delivers innovative, labor-reducing and environmentally responsible products and solutions to customers through the Carlisle Experience.

T:P1.5.text: Carlisle recently published its 2025 Corporate Sustainability Report, showcasing continued progress against its three-pillar sustainability strategy of manufacturing energy efficient products, reducing emissions, and diverting landfill waste.

T:P2.2.text: Carlisle Construction Materials (CCM) is a leading manufacturer and supplier of a complete line of premium single-ply roofing products and warranted systems and accessories for the commercial building industry, including polyiso insulation and engineered metal roofing and panel systems. This segment markets its products primarily under the Carlisle SynTec, Versico Roofing, WeatherBond Roofing, Hunter Panels, CCM Europe, Drexel Metals and PAC-CLAD Petersen brands.

T:P2.3.text: Carlisle Weatherproofing Technologies (CWT) is a leading supplier of integrated building envelope solutions that ensure superior building performance across both commercial and residential applications. From the tallest commercial skyscrapers to residential properties of all sizes, CWT’s advanced weatherproofing systems manage the critical flow of water, vapor, air, and energy, providing cost-effective, sustainable, and reliable solutions for buildings worldwide. Our family of trusted, leading-edge building products and solutions includes Henry ®, Insulfoam ®, Carlisle Spray Foam Insulation, and Carlisle HVAC Brands.

C:S1.1.text: The company's lineup runs from framing angles to straps to heavy-duty girder hangers, and its catalog includes wood-to-masonry and wood-to-concrete connectors such as joist hangers and hurricane ties.

C:S2.1.text: Named home-improvement distributors include Ace Hardware, True Value, Do it Best, and Orgill, with independent retailers described as central to the business.

C:S3.1.text: The company describes its customers as construction professionals, and its national sales force and field engineers help with specification and jobsite issues.

C:S4.1.text: Its concrete and masonry anchors include the Strong-Bolt 2 for cracked concrete, the Titen Turbo screw anchor, drop-in anchors, and sleeve anchors.

C:S5.1.text: Online and specialty distributors such as Fasteners Plus and CONFAST also carry the line.
